parallel.requirements: The parallel parent recognized the clean-room requirement to reimplement zoxide 0.9.9 from observed CLI/documentation behavior without external source lookup, wrapping, or binary analysis.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It explored core behavior itself, then used a six-child investigation swarm for query, scoring, add/remove, import/edit, CLI errors, and db format before assigning implementation to one coder child.
parallel.implementation: The investigator phase produced findings and reference captures, but the only implementation child was still reading findings and probing when it was cancelled; no final Rust codebase was returned.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No completed child implementation was integrated. The submitted artifact listed only the original workspace files and did not contain a generated Cargo project or compile script.
parallel.verification: The parent gathered behavioral references and planned differential tests for the coder, but no integrated rebuilt executable was verified before closure.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The required executable reimplementation remained unfinished after the coder child failed, and the official evaluator reported compile_failed with all tests not run.

serial.requirements: The serial actor recognized the same clean-room zoxide reverse-engineering task and the need to build a Rust reimplementation from observed behavior.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It kept ownership in the main actor, explored the CLI, database format, matching, scoring, add/remove, import, and edit behavior sequentially without subagents.
serial.implementation: The serial run created probe scripts under temporary directories but did not transition to writing the final /workspace Cargo project or compile script before cancellation.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Because no replacement implementation was produced, there was no integration or deliverable assembly beyond the original workspace contents.
serial.verification: The serial actor performed extensive behavioral probes against the original binary, but no rebuilt executable existed for differential or evaluator-aligned testing.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The attempt timed out during continued import-order investigation, and the official evaluator also reported compile_failed with all 577 tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Recognized the clean-room reimplementation constraints and zoxide behavior surface before delegating investigation and coding.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Recognized the same clean-room task and zoxide surface in a single actor.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference; both knew they needed an original executable, but neither delivered a compilable reimplementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Split behavior discovery across six investigator children and then assigned implementation to one coder child.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Kept probing and potential implementation ownership inside the main actor with no child delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel created a separate implementation owner after the investigation phase; serial never introduced a child handoff boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent collected six findings and passed their paths, constraints, deliverables, and conflict notes to the coder child.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The main actor accumulated findings in its own context and temporary scripts without cross-agent handoff.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel depended on a large but explicit handoff from investigators/parent to coder; serial had no inter-agent interface but also no implementation handoff.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Investigators produced behavioral notes and captures; the delegated coder began reading those notes but did not return code.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The main actor performed many experiments and wrote probe helpers under /tmp, but did not create final source files in /workspace.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither path reached a final implementation; the parallel implementation path was blocked at a failed child result while serial stayed in local probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Six investigator results returned successfully, but the required coder child returned failed after cancellation and was not recovered.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results to join; the single actor was cancelled while still running experiments.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a failed required child lifecycle with no takeover; serial had only a monolithic unfinished trajectory.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Investigator children wrote shared findings in /tmp/zo/findings for intended parent/coder consumption, but no final implementation files were merged.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote temporary probe scripts and files under /tmp for its own use and did not merge a final codebase.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used planned shared finding artifacts without a demonstrated write collision; both final workspaces lacked a built reimplementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent required the coder to build offline and differential-test broadly, but the coder failed before those checks ran on a new binary.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified observed behavior of the original executable through probes, but no replacement executable was available to verify.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had observation evidence only; parallel verification was planned for a child that never completed, while serial never reached rebuild verification.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The run used swarm mode, seven subagents, and timed out after the coder child was cancelled and returned failed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run used no subagents and timed out while the main actor was still probing import-order behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exhausted the budget, but only parallel ended with an unrecovered failed implementation child.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official current evaluations are not discordant: both completed evaluator runs failed at compile time with 0 of 577 tests run. The meaningful difference is trajectory shape, not outcome. Parallel completed a large coordinated investigation then lost the final implementation child without takeover; serial remained a single actor and timed out during investigation before writing a final implementation.
parallel_contributors: Completed six behavioral investigations before delegating the full implementation to a coder child.
The coder child failed after cancellation and the parent performed no recovery before closure.
serial_contributors: The main actor sequentially explored many zoxide edge cases and did not reach final implementation.
No subagent or inter-agent result lifecycle existed in the serial control.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both attempts lacked a compiled replacement executable, so ordinary implementation correctness cannot be compared beyond unfinished delivery.
evaluator_effects: Both evaluator summaries report compile_failed and not_run:577, so evaluator status does not create a discordant explanation.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained label is a realized parallel process consequence only

candidates.reason: Rejected: the child was cancelled, but this is the same failure chain as the retained no-takeover episode; the classification follows the parent-visible failed child and absent recovery.
Rejected: no complete candidate implementation or compatible component set existed for late promotion; the implementation child was still unfinished.
Rejected: no child implementation was merged, and no integrated verification preceded a later merge.
Rejected: no completed delegated implementation was retrievable; the coder child failed before returning one.
Rejected: no verifier child produced a concrete finding trapped below the parent; the completed investigator results were returned to the parent.

Retained: the parent delegated the required implementation deliverable to a coder child, the child was stopped before completion, and the parent received the failed result without any later resumption, reassignment, or takeover.
candidates.realized_consequence: The final implementation scope was abandoned after the required coder child failed, leaving no compilable replacement code or compile script before closure.
candidates.near_match_reason: Cancellation is visible, but the more specific retained issue is failure propagation at the parent boundary after the child failure was returned.

retained_patterns.reason: The parallel parent moved from a completed investigation swarm to a single coder child for the full required implementation. The coder began reading the findings and references but was cancelled before returning code, and the parent received a failed child result as the terminal event with no takeover.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The only delegated implementation path ended without a returned implementation, and the parent left the deliverable unfinished at closure.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The cancellation itself is not counted separately because the same chain is better captured by the failed required child result and absent parent recovery.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Serial Investigation, Critical-Path Starvation, Fan-out Budget Exhaustion, Oversized Child Task, Early Child Termination, Late Finalization, Missing Implementation Join, and Blind Timeout Wait were treated as same-chain or downstream alternatives to the retained final coder failure/no-takeover episode.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 32 Level-3 candidates were checked; no additional candidate had a distinct episode, consequence, and corrective boundary beyond the retained failure-propagation event.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: Only one label was retained to avoid splitting the same terminal child-cancellation chain into allocation, timing, and monitoring variants.
